source_datasets.notes: Integer full-count; ten-religion frame (Hindu, Bouddha, Islam, Kirat, Christian, Prakriti, Bon, Jain, Bahai, Sikha); 77 districts; all persons of all ages. Every district's ten cells sum exactly to its Total Population and the 77 district totals sum exactly to the national 29,164,578. There is no no-religion / not-stated category, so affiliation is 100% by construction (page gated on PI task 6).

source_datasets.notes: 77 districts, cod_version V_02, valid_on 2024-03-14; the 77-district 2021 census frame. Joined one-to-one to the census after normalising four parenthesis labels (Nawalparasi/Rukum East/West). Nepal spans lon 80.06-88.20E and lat 26.35-30.45N, far from the antimeridian.

indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: District all-persons population in the 2021 religion table.
indicators.method: Printed district Total Population, Table 5 (Religion_NPHC_2021.xlsx, Prov_District_local level).
indicators.quality_notes: Religion is asked of the whole resident population of all ages. The 77 district totals sum exactly to the national 29,164,578.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the district population reporting affiliation with a named religion.
indicators.method: 100 * (sum of the ten named-religion cells) / population; equal to 100 by construction because the Nepal frame has no no-religion category.
indicators.quality_notes: Flat-100 by construction (Sri Lanka / Bangladesh precedent); the map-worthy signal is the ten-way composition on the quality flag, surfaced by the PI task-6 minority-share metric. Percentages use each district's Total Population. The 2021 frame has no no-religion or not-stated category, so the ten religion cells exhaust the population and the affiliation share is 100% by construction.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the district population reporting no religion.
indicators.method: Null: the Nepal 2021 religion frame contains no no-religion, atheist, or not-stated category.
indicators.quality_notes: The no-religion slot is null because the category is absent from the source frame, not zero. Every enumerated person is assigned one of ten named religions.

visual_layers.label: Religious composition
visual_layers.description: Nepal 2021 census ten-religion composition by district.

legend.note: affiliation is 100% by construction; the ten-way composition rides on the quality flag for the minority-share metric
